sites.rationale: [Literature audit 2026-11-05 (deliverome-analysis PR 236), verdict region_only: insert_after_residue 57 -> NULL; the paper names a region, not a junction (region: first predicted extracellular loop). Paper (PMID 34235268): "a custom plasmid containing the codon optimized CDS of SLC46A2 (pTwist-SLC46A2) was linearized with AfeI and an oligonucleotide encoding a GGSG-linker flanked FLAG tag (Table S1) was ligated". Audit note: Secondary source: ACS SI pdf oc1c00440_si_001.pdf (PMC8228594, doi 10.1021/acscentsci.1c00440). Table S1 gives only the blunt 48-nt insert GGSG_FLAG_GGSG top/bottom oligos (GGCGGATCCGGC-GACTACAAAGACGATGACGACAAG-GGCGGATCCGGC), not the AfeI junction. Figure S1A draws the first extracellular loop V44-F77 of human SLC46A2 with the FLAG arrow pointing at the S59 circle (A58/S59 boundary). AfeI (AGC^GCT) cuts on a codon boundary only in frame 0 (Ser-Ala), and the only S-A in loop 44-77 is S57|A58, so 57 (row) is the only clean-junction reading and 58/59 the figure reading; the codon-optimized Twist sequence is not published or deposited, so the junction stays unpinned (57 or 58).] L2 specifies AfeI linearisation of the SLC46A2 CDS within the first extracellular loop; AfeI cuts AGCGCT (Ser-Ala). Python search of the canonical 475-aa sequence finds exactly one SA dipeptide in ECL1 (45-76): S57-A58, 13 residues from the TM1 C-boundary (44) and 20 residues from the TM2 N-boundary (77), both well above the 3-residue minimum. L1 and L3 corroborate the same construct and the surface-staining result. Full-length SLC46A2 expressed in HEK293T cells; the codon-optimised CDS was linearised with AfeI (recognition sequence AGCGCT, encoding Ser-Ala) and a GGSG-FLAG-GGSG oligonucleotide was ligated into the blunt cut site. The only AfeI-compatible SA dipeptide within ECL1 (residues 45-76) is at positions 57-58, placing the insert between S57 and A58. Cells were dissociated with PBS/EDTA (non-permeabilising) and stained for surface FLAG.

sources.claim: To generate doxycycline inducible lentiviral plasmids, the transporter CDS was amplified from the appropriate plasmid using the primers listed in Table S1 and cloned into an Eco RI/ Bam HI linearized pLVX-TetOne-FLAG-Hydro plasmid 18 by isothermal Gibson assembly. 68 To create a construct encoding SLC46A2 with an extracellular loop FLAG tag (pTwist-SLC46A2-exFLAG), a custom plasmid containing the codon optimized CDS of SLC46A2 (pTwist-SLC46A2) was linearized with AfeI and an oligonucleotide encoding a GGSG-linker flanked FLAG tag ( Table S1 ) was ligated into the cut site.
